description: Verify-first surface plus the formal/certified production lane. Layered on core, so the three claim/verification front doors (jackal_claim, jackal_verify_bundle, jackal_verify_receipt) remain present: a profile that could produce a formal receipt but not replay one would let an agent emit assurance it cannot itself re-check, and core must remain a subset of formal. The added ten are exactly the tools whose lane terminates in a Lean-proved checker over an embedded certificate: jackal_range_bound (formal-bounded range receipt with certificate), jackal_gaussian_integral (zero-libm Gaussian receipt, checker rerun), jackal_integrate_bound_cert (v1.7 certified bound_step composed definite integral, theorem int_cert_sound), and the seven pure-Q rat-bound family members jackal_sqrt_rat_bound, jackal_exp_rat_bound, jackal_ln_rat_bound, jackal_sin_rat_bound, jackal_cos_rat_bound, jackal_atan_rat_bound and jackal_tanh_rat_bound, each of which routes an untrusted exact-rational producer through a Lean-proved checker with no libm on the proof-decision path. Deliberately excluded: jackal_integrate_bound, whose enclosure is conditional on a stated f64/libm rounding model and is campaign-tested rather than machine-proved, and every exact/checked/estimated lane tool, including the exact-cert emitters, since a computationally exact certificate outside the Lean chain is not formal-bounded.
